title: Designed NIR-I Emissive and Selective G-Quadruplex DNA Binder with Altered Organelle Specificity.
authors: Metangle, Sachin; Gupta, Harikesh Kumar; Das, Nabanita; Tiwari, Ratnesh; Ranjan, Nihar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子配体对G-四链体DNA的选择性结合与近红外发光，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作之外的核酸配体结合，但无TF-DNA体系、无AI/物理模拟方法，仅含对接与实验，故相关性较低。
abstract: In this work, we report the discovery of a G-quadruplex DNA-selective and near-infrared (NIR-I) emissive G-quadruplex binder derived from a known styryl-quinolinium-based compound. This molecule is unique in its class, with an emission wavelength above 800 nm, and displays selective G-quadruplex binding. Among the synthesized molecules, compound 2 emerged as a selective and the best G-quadruplex binder through comparative studies and exhibited strong thermal stabilization on Pu22 G-quadruplex with a DeltaTm of 21.7  degrees C (at a 1:3 DNA to ligand ratio). G-quadruplex DNA-binding studies showed that thermal stabilization was topology-dependent. CD, UV-vis, and docking studies were performed to confirm the binding of these compounds to the different G-quadruplexes. Solution NMR studies confirmed the binding of compound 2 to the Pu22 G-quadruplex DNA. Cell-based studies showed that compound 2 was significantly cytotoxic to MCF-7 cancer cells and was readily taken up by the cells. However, cell internalization studies showed contrasting changes in the internalization properties, with compound 2 displaying a significant population on the nuclear periphery, which was altogether different from its parent compound 1, which did not show such changes.
abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们报道了一种源自已知苯乙烯基喹啉鎓类化合物的G-四链体DNA选择性且近红外（NIR-I）发射的G-四链体结合剂的发现。该分子在其类别中具有独特性，发射波长超过800 nm，并表现出选择性的G-四链体结合能力。在合成的分子中，通过比较研究，化合物2脱颖而出，成为选择性的且最佳的G-四链体结合剂，并对Pu22 G-四链体表现出强烈的热稳定性，其ΔTm为21.7摄氏度（在DNA与配体比例为1:3时）。G-四链体DNA结合研究表明，热稳定性具有拓扑结构依赖性。进行了CD、UV-vis和对接研究，以确认这些化合物与不同G-四链体的结合。溶液NMR研究证实了化合物2与Pu22 G-四链体DNA的结合。基于细胞的研究表明，化合物2对MCF-7癌细胞具有显著的细胞毒性，并能被细胞迅速摄取。然而，细胞内化研究显示内化特性存在对比性变化，化合物2在核周显示出显著分布，这与其母体化合物1完全不同，后者未表现出此类变化。
